acceptanceScope: Temporary accountable role assignment for the pre-pilot project
limitations: Role acceptance does not approve any decision that remains proposed or needs_context.
Production, legal, privacy, security, source-rights and research-quality decisions require their own evidence gates.
Roles may be reassigned to qualified specialists before the gate that requires their substantive approval.
source: Direct project-sponsor confirmation in the current Codex project thread on 2026-10-18
